comment: Capability ownership for AI-tooling plugins across governed workspaces — the
plugin-axis analog of environment/ide/policy.json. Deliberately contains no
extension IDs, no plugin@marketplace ids, and no Cursor plugin paths: those are
rendering, and live in render.cursor.json / render.claude.json. Workspace
classification lives in exceptions.yaml, mirroring the IDE profile's pattern.

core_default.description: Every governed workspace. Only the core capabilities above — no class-specific addon.

odoo_plasticos.description: Odoo/PlasticOS repos (see exceptions.yaml). Adds the Odoo-native rule bundle.

aws_infra.description: Repos with AWS/CDK/IaC surface. Adds AWS operational guidance.

zep_memory.description: Repos integrating Zep context graphs. Adds Zep-specific guidance.
